_meta.rollback: Delete the two new collections (analysis_run, functional_test_evidence). The new defects fields are additive text/json/number columns — SQL-drop via ALTER TABLE. Type code rollback requires replaying migration v1 codes from backup.
notes: Additive for the collections; partially destructive for Type codes (v1 values in photo_meta.iso_filename are rewritten; a backup table photo_meta_v1_backup is created as part of step 4 below).

The migration has four phases. Phases 1-3 are independently reversible. Phase 4 (Type code rewrite) is lossy for CQF records that cannot be disambiguated — see conquas-evidence-spec.md §3 migration mapping.
Matches the text-FK convention (pins.drawingId style) for all new relations.

Per the auth-only rule convention, list/view/create/update/delete rules are all '@request.auth.id != \'\''. Project-scoping and role-based restrictions (e.g. 'only admins can edit locked_fields') are enforced in application code, not PB rules — consistent with Step 2.

phase_3_defaults_backfill.description: Populate defaults for the new defects fields over existing rows. Idempotent, can be dry-run. Implemented as tools/backfill-evidence-role.js (to be written in Step 3 implementation, not now).
rules: evidence_role: derive via conquas-evidence-spec.md §3 mapping. defects with checkpoint_id matching CONQUAS pattern get 'IF' or 'EF' per element; defects flagged as FT via existing QP toggles get the matching FT code; non-CONQUAS work categories (Interior, FM, Infra, Others) get null.
major_defect_flag: true when evidence_role == 'MD', else false.
common_area_flag: derived from defects.locationZone via the project information standard's common-area list. Null on projects without a defined list.
latent_defect_flag: false for all backfilled rows (operators opt in later).

phase_4_type_code_migration.description: Rewrite photo_meta.iso_filename cached values to use v2.0 workflow codes. The cached filenames are not authoritative (they're regenerated on export per iso19650-photo-meta-spec.md §3), so this phase is strictly about cache consistency. Defects' own filename build on next save uses the new vocabulary automatically once defects.evidence_role is populated (phase 3).
steps: 1. Create backup table: CREATE TABLE photo_meta_v1_backup AS SELECT id, iso_filename, updated FROM photo_meta;

2. For each photo_meta row, parse iso_filename via parseIso19650Filename, apply the v1→v2 Type remap from codification-standard.md §7.3, re-emit via isoNameForDefect (post-Step-3 build that reads defects.evidence_role), and write back.
3. For CQF → ambiguous rows, set photo_meta.quality.warnings ||= ['type_migration_ambiguous'] and emit iso_filename with 'EVD'. Produce a review CSV listing these for CONQUAS team triage.
4. Report: rows scanned / remapped / ambiguous / errors.
5. Keep photo_meta_v1_backup for 30 days post-soak; drop after confirmation from the CONQUAS team.
phase_4_type_code_migration._rollback: Restore photo_meta.iso_filename from photo_meta_v1_backup. Note: defects.evidence_role values from phase 3 remain — explicit rollback of that column requires a separate ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN.

_apply_checklist: 0. CONFIRM apply_gate items are all true. If any gate is not met, STOP.
1. Back up pb_data/ to off-box storage.
2. Apply phase 1 (new collections) via PB Admin Import. Verify empty tables, 9-field shape on analysis_run, 14-field shape on functional_test_evidence.
4. Apply phase 2 (defects field additions) via PB Admin field editor.
5. Ship the hook outline v1.1 code to pb_hooks/main.pb.js. Start in shadow mode (ISO_STEP3_ENFORCE = false).
6. Run phase 3 backfill dry-run. Spot-check 20 defects with mixed work categories. Confirm evidence_role derivation looks right.
8. Run phase 4 type-code migration dry-run. Export the 'ambiguous CQF' list to CSV for the CONQUAS team to review before real run.
9. CONQUAS team reviews ambiguous list; resolves by editing defects.evidence_role directly where possible.
10. Run phase 4 for real. Verify photo_meta_v1_backup exists.
11. Switch hooks to enforce mode after 24h shadow-mode soak.
12. Ship client code: evidence timeline panel, lock toggles, RE-ANALYZE single-entry button.
13. Promote to production in the same order.
14. Measure for 1 sprint: lock usage, re-analyze ignored-field rates, QP declaration stuck-at-pending rates.
_rollback_checklist: Pre-phase-4: drop new collections (analysis_run, functional_test_evidence) and new defects fields. No data loss.
Post-phase-4 pre-client-ship: restore iso_filename values from photo_meta_v1_backup. Drop new collections + defects fields.
Post-client-ship: revert client code first, THEN data rollback. Otherwise client tries to render fields that no longer exist.
